summary: Significant improvements to video decoding infrastructure across platforms, with **enabling Vulkan-based video decoding on Linux for better performance with NVIDIA hardware** as a major enhancement. Critical fixes address HDR metadata bugs that caused washed-out colors in hardware-decoded videos, support for FFmpeg 63 is added, and platform-specific decoders for Apple Video Toolbox and Windows Media Foundation are refined. Work also improves codec capability detection, optimizes NVIDIA graphics handling, and ensures proper colorspace preservation throughout decoding.
